name: Dr. Tanveer Ahmed
comment: The speech therapy team at Cares Bangladesh is exceptional. Within 4 months, our son made unbelievable progress in his expressive speech and confidence. We are truly grateful!

name: Farhana Rahman
comment: The sensory integration and occupational therapy provided here helped our daughter tremendously with her coordination and focus. The therapists are so caring and patient.

name: Mohammad Hossain
comment: A warm, inclusive, and professional environment. Their ABA program and behavior therapy have made daily routines at home and school so much smoother.

name: Nusrat Jahan
comment: Best therapy center in Uttara Dhaka. The staff genuinely care about each child’s individual growth. Highly recommended!
